# JARVIS v2.0.9 Release Notes

### Highlights & New Features:
- **Afreen Natural Islamic Expressions & Kalimat**: Authentic, respectful usage of common Islamic expressions (*Alhamdulillah, Mashallah, SubhanAllah, InshaAllah, Astaghfirullah, Bismillah, Allahu Akbar, JazakAllah Khair, BarakAllahu Feek, Assalamu Alaikum, Wa Alaikum Assalam*) exclusively in Girlfriend Mode.
- **Contextual Emoji Intelligence**: Emotional mapping for chat messages (love, joy, care, sympathy, excitement, appreciation, duas, playful banter) with strict restraint against emoji chains.
- **Voice & Text Synchronization**: Emojis are strictly visual in chat bubbles; Google Gemini Live neural voice Aoede and local speech engines never vocalize emoji names.
- **Explicit Consent Memory System**: Completely neutralized conversational auto-memory scraping; casual chit-chat is never saved as permanent memory.
- **User Profile Name Protection**: Name changes are strictly locked to explicit profile settings; conversational names or nicknames can never overwrite the user's name. Corrupted profile names are automatically sanitized on startup.
- **Room Database Migration v2**: Added explicit consent tracking (`isExplicitConsent`), auto-purge of corrupt records, and an in-app "Clear Auto-Saved" memory review tool.
- **Strict Personality Isolation**: All Afreen companion features remain 100% isolated from JARVIS Pro (executive butler) and Silent Soul (neural core).
